[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/22 (Mon) 02:12  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To configure the transaction log (translog) in Elasticsearch using `django-elasticsearch-dsl`, you can add a `settings` attribute to your `Document` class in `search_indexes.py`.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Example code provided for configuring the transaction log in Elasticsearch.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The `flush_threshold_size` setting controls the maximum size of the transaction log before it is flushed to disk.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The `sync_interval` setting controls how frequently the transaction log is synced to disk.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Once you've set the translog settings, you can reindex your data using the `python manage.py search_index --rebuild` command.  
[USER] Asked for an explanation of the use cases for different storage options in Elasticsearch: mmapfs, niofs, and hybridfs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] `mmapfs` is the default storage type, using memory-mapped files for fast access, effective for small indices that fit in memory.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] `niofs` uses the Java New I/O (NIO) API, suitable for environments where mmapfs is unsupported or for frequent writes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] `hybridfs` combines mmapfs and niofs, providing fast read access and efficient write performance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended using `mmapfs` for small indices, `niofs` for large indices or frequent writes, and `hybridfs` for moderate-sized indices needing both read and write efficiency.  
[USER] Mentioned setting the refresh interval to 1 minute.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided an API call to set the refresh interval to 1 minute in Elasticsearch.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested adding the refresh interval setting in `settings.py` for `django-elasticsearch-dsl`.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Warned that a low refresh interval can impact performance due to more frequent index refreshing.  
[USER] Asked how to index 10 rows at a time instead of automatically indexing each row when a new row is inserted into the table.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested using the Elasticsearch bulk API for indexing multiple rows at a time to improve performance.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Provided example code for bulk indexing 10 rows at a time using the `bulk()` method of the `Index` object in `django-elasticsearch-dsl`.
